title: Structs, Text Files, and a Progress Tracker
summary: Combine structs, enums, fixed buffers, checked file I/O, parsing, and modular functions in a small persistent tracker.
learningObjectives: Explain and apply Structs, Text Files, and a Progress Tracker
Compile and test behavior with warnings enabled
prerequisiteConcepts: Ability to create and save a text file

sections.heading: Core model
sections.content: A struct groups related fields into one record; an enum gives meaningful names to integral states. Fixed character arrays require space for the terminating null character. Copy and format with bounded functions, always checking truncation and return values. File functions return status: verify `fopen`, check each read or write, and call `fclose`. Text persistence needs a documented format and validation when loaded because files are untrusted input. Separate parsing, domain updates, calculations, and presentation so each function has a testable contract.
keyPoints: A struct groups related fields into one record; an enum gives meaningful names to integral states.
commonMistakes: const does not necessarily make the original object globally immutable
